---
name: "Review LinkedIn Performance"
description: "Review recorded LinkedIn post results by pillar, audience, hook, format, and timing, then recommend two testable improvements."
agent: "LinkedIn Content Orchestrator"
argument-hint: "Optional date range or campaign name"
---

Review comparable records in `content/metrics/` and their approved source posts.

1. State the date range, sample size, and missing data.
2. Compare raw 24-hour and 7-day results separately.
3. Segment results by content pillar, audience, hook type, format, and posting time when the sample supports it.
4. Do not infer causation from correlation or generalize from one post.
5. Recommend at most two specific experiments for the next four weeks.
6. Save the review under `content/reviews/` without changing prior records.
